title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled whelk the size of a teacup, who glides across a moonlit sand floor on a ribbon of silver mucus and pirouettes slowly whenever the bubbles from a tiny sunken music box rise past her. Her tank is hushed and teal, lit by a single soft lantern-glow from above, with drifting sea-grass, a cracked porcelain teacup for a ballroom, and a trail of spiral footprints marking every dance she's ever done.
